name: Te Chang Construction Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating across Taiwan and Thailand, Te Chang Construction Co., Ltd. specializes in construction contracting and civil engineering projects. Its extensive portfolio encompasses a broad spectrum of developments, including public infrastructure, healthcare facilities, educational institutions, diverse housing solutions (public, residential, and commercial), high-tech industrial plants, office complexes, land development initiatives, and the reconstruction of military housing. Beyond its core construction activities, the firm offers a range of complementary services such as residential property leasing and sales, comprehensive building systems engineering (covering electrical, mechanical, fire safety, and HVAC), wastewater treatment solutions, integrated manufacturing, and end-to-end construction planning, design, and management. Furthermore, the company's activities extend to general retail and department store operations. It also engages in the supply and trade of various goods, including tires, bicycles and parts, specialized building materials like mortar and ready-mixed concrete, household stones, and a broader range of building materials at both wholesale and retail levels. Property trading is another facet of its diversified portfolio. Te Chang Construction Co., Ltd. was established in 1986 and maintains its headquarters in Taichung City, Taiwan.
